paper_title: Adapting Whisper for Regional Dialects Enhancing Public Services for   Vulnerable Populations in the United Kingdom
caption: Difference in average word error rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 after cumulative automated optimisation steps.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the difference in average word error rate (WER) from Whisper large-v3 after cumulative automated optimisation steps, comparing two models: the NESAC ft model and the SESH A ft model. The vertical axis represents the “Difference in average WER from Whisper large” and ranges from 0.000 to 0.003, with tick intervals of 0.0001, and units of “”. The horizontal axis displays the models, labeled “NESAC ft model” and “SESH A ft model,” and is ordered from left to right. The NESAC ft model bar is orange and extends to 0.00302, while the SESH A ft model bar is green and extends to 0.00334. The bar representing the “Add spacing applied” optimisation is green and has a value of 0.00344, while the "Remove spacing" optimisation is green and has a value of 0.00311. The “Dates” optimisation is green and extends to 0.00306, and the “Americanisms” optimisation is green, with a value of 0.00302. The bar labeled "Normalised” is orange and extends to 0.00334.
